final: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_records_won, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p2 ON p2.player_id = ma.player_id) AS share_of_award_records FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.bats, ''), '')
